description: Dangee Dums Limited engages in the manufacturing and trading of bakery and confectionery products in India. The company offers cookies and baked treats, beverages, brownies, cakes, chocolates, cupcakes, hampers, ice cream, pastries, cheesecakes, and savories, as well as party kits under the Dangee Dums, Dangee Dums Gourmet, and Dangee Dums Yums brands. It also operates franchise stores. The company sells its products through retail stores and outlets; and food delivery apps. Dangee Dums Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
